messages:
zoe: Opened a PR to fix inconsistencies in the API ref for POST /v1/ingest — examples use `uid`, `user`, and `user_id` interchangeably; schema marks `metadata` required but server accepts null/omitted. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4601

ben: Reproduced on staging. Server accepts both `uid` and `user_id` for now, but docs should present `user_id` as canonical. Agree that `metadata` should be documented as nullable/optional and we should show three example variants (object, null, omitted).

zoe: Plan in the PR: (1) canonicalize examples to `user_id`, (2) update OpenAPI schema to "nullable object" and add description "may be omitted or null", (3) add example payloads: with metadata object, with metadata null, and with metadata omitted, (4) update curl/node/python snippets to match, (5) add a short migration note mapping `uid -> user_id`. Also adding a tiny docs CI smoke test that parses example JSON to catch future drift.

ben: Sounds good. One nit: in Python snippets use `metadata=None` not `{}` to avoid implying empty object. Also add a short deprecation timeline in the migration note.

zoe: Will update PR with those nits and ping for review when CI passes.

docs-bot: PR opened by zoe: #4601 "ingest API: canonicalize field names + nullable metadata". CI queued.
